title: 玉楼春·春景
titleEn: Jade Tower Spring · A Spring Scene
author: 宋祁
intro: A spring outing on the water: rippling waves, misty willows, apricot blossoms so thick they seem noisy — and a toast to the setting sun, begging it to stay a little longer.
analysis: 这首词写春天出游。上阕写景：城东的风光一天比一天好，水面上泛起细细的波纹，像在欢迎游船；远处绿柳像笼着一层烟，清晨只有一点点凉意；近处红杏开满枝头，春意“闹”得正欢。这个“闹”字最有名：花本来不会发出声音，词人却用一个表示声音的字，把杏花开得热热闹闹、蜂飞蝶舞的样子全写出来了——把看到的写成听到的，这种手法叫“通感”。宋祁也因此被人称为“红杏尚书”。下阕抒情：人生在世，总是苦恼欢乐太少，谁肯为了千金而轻视一次开心的笑呢？所以要为朋友举杯劝夕阳，请它在花丛间多留一会儿。表面是赏春，里面是珍惜时光、及时行乐的人生感慨。
analysisEn: This lyric is about a spring outing. The first stanza paints the scene: the east side of the city grows lovelier by the day, fine ripples on the water seem to welcome the boats, the willows in the distance look wrapped in mist, the morning chill is only slight — and on the branches of the red apricot trees “spring is noisy”. That word 闹 (“noisy, bustling”) is what made the poem famous. Flowers make no sound, yet one noisy word lets you feel the crowd of blossoms and the buzzing of bees. Describing something seen with a word for something heard is called tōnggǎn (“synaesthesia”). It earned Song Qi the nickname “the Red Apricot Minister”. The second stanza turns to feeling: life is short and happy moments are few, so who would value a fortune more than a good laugh? He raises his cup to the setting sun on his friends’ behalf and asks it to linger among the flowers. A spring scene becomes a reminder to treasure the moment.
background: Song Qi (998–1061) was a Northern Song scholar-official who helped compile the New History of the Tang. This lyric made him famous; people called him the “Red Apricot Minister” after its best-known line.
pronunciation: 縠 hú（有皱纹的纱）；棹 zhào（船桨，代指船）；长恨 cháng hèn；为君 wèi jūn；斜阳 xié yáng（旧读 xiá，今按 xié）。机器朗读“縠、棹、长”容易读错，已在“朗读用字”列换成同音字，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行文本。词牌一作《木兰花》。异文：“縠皱波纹”一作“皱縠波纹”（《草堂诗馀》）；“晓寒轻”一作“晓云轻”；“浮生长恨”一作“浮生常恨”。网站均从通行教材本。

lines.py: dōng chéng jiàn jué fēng guāng hǎo
lines.lit: East of the city, I gradually feel the scenery is fine;
lines.en: Day by day the east of the city grows lovelier;

lines.py: hú zhòu bō wén yíng kè zhào
lines.lit: silk-crinkle ripples welcome the visitors’ oars.
lines.en: ripples fine as crinkled silk come to meet our boat.

lines.py: lǜ yáng yān wài xiǎo hán qīng
lines.lit: Beyond the mist of green willows, the dawn chill is light;
lines.en: Past the green haze of the willows, the morning chill is faint;

lines.py: hóng xìng zhī tóu chūn yì nào
lines.lit: on the red apricot branches, spring is noisy.
lines.en: on the red apricot boughs, spring is in uproar.

lines.py: fú shēng cháng hèn huān yú shǎo
lines.lit: In this floating life we always regret that joys are few;
lines.en: All through this drifting life we grieve that joy is rare —

lines.py: kěn ài qiān jīn qīng yī xiào
lines.lit: would I love a thousand in gold and think lightly of one smile?
lines.en: so why prize a fortune over one good laugh?

lines.py: wèi jūn chí jiǔ quàn xié yáng
lines.lit: For you I hold wine and urge the slanting sun
lines.en: For your sake I raise my cup to the setting sun:

lines.py: qiě xiàng huā jiān liú wǎn zhào
lines.lit: to leave its evening light among the flowers a while.
lines.en: stay, and leave your evening glow among the flowers a little longer.

words.note: 縠：有皱纹的薄纱。用来比喻细小的水波，今天不用。
用船桨代指船，今天不用。
古诗里的“烟”常指雾气，不是今天的“烟（smoke）”。
晓：天刚亮，现代汉语“拂晓”“破晓”。
今天“热闹”的“闹”；用在花上是诗人的妙用。
古人觉得人生像浮在水上，漂泊不定，现代汉语书面语仍用，如“浮生若梦”。

words.en: a thousand in gold; a fortune
words.note: 现代汉语仍用，如“一诺千金”。
持：拿，现代汉语“手持”“持有”。

imagery.name: 杏花
imagery.zh: 满枝红杏开得热热闹闹，是春天最浓的时候，一个“闹”字写出了整个春天的生气。
imagery.en: Red apricot blossoms crowding the branches mark spring at its fullest — one “noisy” word brings the whole season to life.

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: 远处的绿柳像笼着一层烟，写出清晨朦胧、微寒的春景。
imagery.en: Distant willows wrapped in green haze give the soft, slightly chilly feel of a spring morning.

imagery.name: 夕阳
imagery.zh: 劝夕阳留步，其实是想留住快乐的时光——夕阳象征时间正在流走。
imagery.en: Asking the setting sun to stay is really asking happy time to stay — the sunset is time slipping away.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 举杯劝夕阳，是及时行乐、珍惜眼前的姿态。
imagery.en: Raising a cup to the sunset is a gesture of enjoying the moment while it lasts.
